T_slag_C: Ferrochrome Data Workbook, Slag sheet, in-furnace temperature, mean
I_electrode_kA: Westly estimate at C1, C3 = 8.33 (A-18); not measured
rho_electrode_uOhm_m: Baked Soderberg carbon at operating temperature, low end of the typical range; replace with supplier data
k_electrode: W/(m K) baked carbon electrode, typical range 5 to 25
k_lining: W/(m K) magnesia-chrome type refractory, typical range 2 to 5
k_burden: W/(m K) effective, porous charge including radiation, typical range 0.5 to 3
h_bottom: W/(m2 K) shell bottom to ambient
h_freeboard: W/(m2 K) electrode and burden surface to furnace gas (convection plus radiation)
T_gas_C: Furnace gas temperature in the freeboard
h_above_roof: W/(m2 K) electrode surface above the roof to ambient
burden_profile_exponent: Charge temperature T_gas + (T_slag - T_gas) * s^n, s = fraction of the burden depth above the bath
z_shoe_top: m: top of the contact-shoe band (current enters the electrode here); band is 1.0 m deep
h_shoe: W/(m2 K) water-cooled contact shoes on the electrode surface
h_above_shoes: W/(m2 K) electrode surface above the shoes to ambient air
z_col_top: m: top of the modelled electrode column (4 m above the support plate)
T_above_roof_C: Air around the electrode above the roof
